# 电商素材工坊 · E-commerce Material Studio
> One-stop pipeline for e-commerce product images: category → style → scene compositing → text → QC
输入产品图，一条流水线出可投放的电商素材：**品类识别 → 风格匹配 → 场景感知合成 → 统一文字 → 自动质检 → 多平台尺寸适配 → 标准化交付**（含使用指南 + 清单 + zip）。
No build step, no account, no telemetry.
iles live in `references/`: category templates, product profiles, brand config template.
`SceneAwareCompositor` is a **library**, not a command-line tool — call it from Python (see above).
Brand assets are configuration, not shipped logos: bring your own.

MIT — see LICENSE. Issues and PRs welcome.
Part of the hermes-skills collection.
